text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. A day to pour your feelings of friendship, romance, or gratitude into chocolates and give them to someone special.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………Trainer.
Do you have a moment?
choice_data_list: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not like that, but...
Well, you know what today is, right? Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-Well... they've taken care of me ever since my debut, right? Consider it common courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You do so much for me, Trainer,
so I really wanted to give this to you properly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's a famous brand, so I guarantee the taste.
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I was looking for you, Dober~.
I knew you'd be here~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Pretty please~? Would you mind
teaching me how to make chocolates~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—In short, you can't just heat up
chocolate directly in a pot to melt it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is a 'water bath'~.
I've got it down completely~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez... You could've come to talk to me earlier
instead of waiting until the day of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~.
How careless of me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I mean,
why are you making one too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I mean, you didn't have to go
out of your way to keep me company, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's way more fun to make it together~
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I want to express my gratitude with chocolates too.
I want to express my gratitude with chocolates too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's way more fun to make it together~
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I want to express my gratitude with chocolates too.
I want to express my gratitude with chocolates too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Huh...
You have someone like that...
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so... But by that,
do you mean the Chairwoman, or maybe Tazuna-san?
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!!
Come on, quit saying weird things and keep your hands moving!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That look on your face... you're teasing me, aren't you?
Fine, don't say it. Can we just hurry up and keep going?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All finished~!
Thank you, Dober~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
All finished~!
Thank you, Dober~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome.
Great job, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to hand them over to Ryan-oneesama and the others, but—
"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I ended up making a bit too much, so
why don't we have a tasting session right here~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's all exchange the chocolates we made♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I shall have some of both of your chocolates as well~.
choice_data_list: Dober, can I have some?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
W-Wait! I'm not mentally prepared...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... Ah, yeah.
If that's what you want, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not that!
Umm, well, geez, come on!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's not from a fancy store or anything, so...
Um... don't get your hopes up too high."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
J-Just eat it already!
I'm not guaranteeing the taste, okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have anyone to give them to...
so please, take as many as you like.

As Mejiro Dober popped the chocolate I made
into her mouth while speaking, her cheeks
were flushed a faint shade of red.

...I'll hand Mejiro Dober her share
a bit later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Before giving it to Sister Ryan and the others,
I thought about giving some to Dober's group, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Don't the two of you have far more suitable opponents for your first match than me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha-!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's not be boorish; let's bite our handkerchiefs
and quietly make our exit here~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second?
Don't tell me, from the very start—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'll come by to hand it over to you properly later~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Oh, Bright, really...!
choice_data_list: ...Looks like it's just the two of us now, huh?
...Looks like it's down to just the two of us, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't phrase it like that!
When you say it that way, it just makes me even more—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't worry about
what Bright said earlier, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Shut up... you idiot...!
choice_data_list: For now, eat some sweets and calm down.
The one I want to give it to is Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your chocolates turned out pretty great, Trainer.
Whoever receives them is bound to be happy.
choice_data_list: For now, eat some sweets and calm down.
The one I want to give it to is Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you say—wait, chocolate?
choice_data_list: Happy Valentine's Day! ...It's a little clumsy, though.
It might look clumsy, but I put my heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: F-For me?
choice_data_list: Happy Valentine's Day! ...It's a little clumsy, though.
It might look clumsy, but I put my heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Why do you always have to... ugh! Doing the things I can't do so easily—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I look pretty pathetic, huh. Getting cold feet and trying to run away to something store-bought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ..................That's just unfair.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
You're right, it's the thought that counts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
I feel like an idiot for trying to run away."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I know this is the second time,
but will you accept it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Take it. ...Just so you know,
I won't let you get away with just forcing yours on me and leaving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It might not be perfect like high-end brand stuff, but...
this is the best I can do right now.
